newsitem.title: USA: USF&G posted 100 pct gain in life results.
newsitem.headline: USF&G posted 100 pct gain in life results.

text.p: USF&G Corp said it posted a nearly 100 percent increase in the results of its life company.
"Their increasing profitability continues to reflect the significant progress being made in sales, improving margins, and aggressive cost management," USF&G chairman Norman Blake said in a statement.
Life insurance operating results, net income prior to realized gains and losses and income taxes, totaled $13 million in the 1996 third quarter compared to $7 million a year ago.
